description: This file defines the Enforcement interface, which models data used to enforce matching rules for inputs against filters with placeholders. It includes methods for retrieving input strings and filter sets, as well as nested class for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: Enforcement
classes.description: An interface representing enforcement rules for matching inputs against filters with placeholders. Includes methods to retrieve input strings and filters, and JSON serialization methods.

classes.name: Enforcement.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class containing JSON field definitions for Enforcement, including 'input' and 'filters'.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Returns the string input to be matched against filters.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns a set of filter strings containing placeholders.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts Enforcement to a JSON object using the default schema version.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts Enforcement to a JSON object with specified schema version and field selector.
